ValidationRule.description: Read privacy script and obtain complainant consent before recording their complaint. If no consent, record anonymously
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c = false, RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Non_Customer_Complaint', IDR_NC_Is_Consent_Obtained__c = false, OR( AND( NOT(ISBLANK(IDR_NC_First_Name__c )), IDR_NC_First_Name__c <> $Label.Anonymous_Complainant ), AND( NOT(ISBLANK(IDR_NC_Middle_Names__c )), IDR_NC_Middle_Names__c <> $Label.Anonymous_Complainant ), AND( NOT(ISBLANK(IDR_NC_Last_Name__c )), IDR_NC_Last_Name__c <> $Label.Anonymous_Complainant ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Read privacy script and obtain complainant consent before recording their complaint. If no consent, do not capture complainant's names.
